address: 50 6/3 Street, Thao Dien Ward, Thu Duc City, Ho Chi Minh City, 713000, Vietnam
bio: In CieL's intimate dining space, inside a modern villa in Thao Dien, you feel like you're in a friend's home. Dining at the ground-floor counter, you can see into the open kitchen set against the backdrop of a lush tropical garden; the upper floor exudes Nordic elegance. French techniques are fused with Vietnamese soul in the ever-evolving tasting menu. Don't miss the fish maw and custard, a sublime East-meets-West creation. Thoughtful service and wine pairings complete the experience....
